title: Refund lanes read RSL status and recommend for claims in audit
scope: Lane proposals apply to claims RSL has placed in audit, read RSL's claim status, and send the lane and undisputed amount to RSL as a recommendation through TAX-124

acceptance.text: Lane proposals record the RSL status they were made against and are not created for claims RSL already processed
No Vati record sets refund status, release or payment; wording says recommendation
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Bench tests across RSL status values

notes.text: Added 2026-11-07 from ADR-043 (Vati downstream of RSL selection; portal answers evidence requests).
